Name: Slightly Cuter-er Penny Portrait - Seasonal
Author: JuanMiguelito
Description:
[font=Arial]A slightly cuter and friendlier redesign of Penny's portrait made for Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. It goes without saying that it is a requirement. This mod simply overwrites the existing portrait of that mod.

Credits to Poltergeister for the awesome mod and designs for festival clothes design. I didn't have to stress over women's fashion; their design is way better than I could come up with.

Although ohodavi's anime portraits is not a requirement as I simply got some inspiration for Penny's emotional expression, I just feel the need to credit the author of that mod. So yeah, credits to ohodavi for such amazing artwork in that mod.


[size=3][b]INSTALLATION:[/b]
[/size][/font][size=3]This mod is a replacer for Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. And so you must simply merge my mod and that mod, my mod should overwrite the assets in that mod (the file is "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters"). Missing sprites are intentional because my portrait still matches the original sprites.

[/size][b][size=3]NOTE:[/size][/b]
Two main files, choose one between the main file or the glasses version. 
[font=Arial]


Thank you for using this mod and appreciate all your feedback, and I hope you enjoy this mod. Although grindy as I encountered a lot of overlooked mess in my work, I still enjoyed making this, and I wish I could make more. [/font]
